airports.name: Salt Lake City International (1986)
airports.location_note: The airport authority dates the International name to 1968 and records terminal/runway work before 1986. Timetable printed pp. 208 and 261 identify Salt Lake City/SLC. Current FAA reference coordinates provide an approximate marker at the same airfield; they do not reconstruct a 1986 terminal, stand, runway threshold or flight path.

airports.name: Nassau International–Windsor Field (1986)
airports.location_note: The Bahamas Department of Aviation identifies Windsor Field as Nassau International from 1957 and dates the Lynden Pindling renaming to 2006; that later name is not backdated. Delta printed pp. 168–169 and 261 identify Nassau/NAS. AirNav publishes estimated modern FAA coordinates; used only as an approximate same-airfield marker, not a reconstructed 1986 gate, runway or aircraft position.

marker_precision: Approximate same-airfield positions; 1986 gates, runway thresholds and layouts not reconstructed.
